props.name: align
props.description:
Alignment of the content along the trigger edge: `'start'` and `'end'` line up the content
edge with the matching trigger edge, `'center'` centers it. Combines with `placement`.

props.name: children
props.description: Composed navigation parts.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description:
Delay in milliseconds between the pointer leaving the menu and the open panel closing. The
panel stays open while focus is inside it, and moving across the gap toward the panel is
tolerated.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
`value` of the item that is open initially when uncontrolled; omit to start closed. Ignored
when `value` is set.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disables every trigger and link in the menu: panels cannot open (an open panel closes) and
links lose their `href` and are marked `aria-disabled`.

props.name: flip
props.description:
Whether the content moves to another side when the preferred `placement` does not fit in the
viewport. `false` keeps the side fixed. An array is an ordered list of fallback `Placement`
values tried in order (each `top`, `right`, `bottom` or `left`, optionally suffixed with
`-start` or `-end`).
examples:
import { Button, Popover } from 'moraine'

<Popover placement="bottom" flip={['top', 'bottom-end']}>
  <Popover.Trigger as={Button}>Details</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover.Content>More information</Popover.Content>
</Popover>

props.name: gutter
props.description: Gap between the trigger and panel, in pixels.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the `value` of the item that should open, or `null` when the menu should close,
after hover, click, keyboard or dismissal. It only fires when the value changes and fires in
controlled mode too, so a controlled menu must write it back to `value`.

props.name: openDelay
props.description:
Delay in milliseconds between a mouse pointer entering a trigger and its panel opening while
no panel is open. Hovering another trigger while a panel is open switches immediately, and
click or keyboard activation never waits.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Axis of the top-level navigation list.

props.name: overflowPadding
props.description: Padding in pixels between positioned content and the viewport boundary.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Side of the trigger the content opens on. The rendered side can differ when `flip` moves it to
fit the viewport; read it from `data-side` on the content.

props.name: shift
props.description:
Offset in pixels along the trigger edge (horizontal for `top` and `bottom` placements,
vertical for `left` and `right`), added to the position given by `align`.

props.name: slide
props.description:
Whether the content slides along the trigger edge (horizontally for `top` and `bottom`
placements, vertically for `left` and `right`) to stay inside the viewport, keeping
`overflowPadding` from the edge, instead of overflowing.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description:
Controlled `value` of the open `NavigationMenu.Item`. `undefined` keeps the menu
uncontrolled; `null` keeps it controlled and closed. A value that matches no enabled item
with content leaves the menu closed. Update it from `onValueChange`.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the element.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the element.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable this item's trigger or direct links.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique item value. Generated when omitted; set explicitly for controlled usage.

props.name: as
props.description:
Element or component to render as. A tag name (`'a'`) renders that element and narrows the
other props to its attributes; a Solid component receives the props the trigger would put on
its element, so it should spread them onto its root and forward `ref`. Own styles and state
attributes are kept.
examples:
import { Button } from 'moraine'

<Button as="a" href="/docs" target="_blank">Docs</Button>

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger label and visual content.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether this trigger is disabled.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.description: Content rendered inside the element.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks this link as the current page by setting `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the element.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description:
Closes the open panel when the link is clicked, unless a click handler calls
`preventDefault()`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disables the link: it loses its `href`, gets `aria-disabled` and `tabindex={-1}`, and clicks
are prevented. A link is also disabled when its `NavigationMenu` or `NavigationMenu.Item` is.

props.name: linkRender
props.description:
Renders the link with a custom component, such as a router link, instead of `<a>`. It is
mounted as a component and receives the merged anchor props (`href`, `class`, `ref`, ARIA
attributes and event handlers), all of which it must forward to its anchor.
examples:
import { NavigationMenu } from 'moraine'
import type { NavigationMenuT } from 'moraine'

const RouterLink = (props: NavigationMenuT.LinkRenderProps) => <a {...props} />

<NavigationMenu aria-label="Main navigation">
  <NavigationMenu.List>
    <NavigationMenu.Item>
      <NavigationMenu.Link href="/docs" linkRender={RouterLink}>
        Documentation
      </NavigationMenu.Link>
    </NavigationMenu.Item>
  </NavigationMenu.List>
</NavigationMenu>
